 KRON San Francisco Follow Preliminary 2.7 earthquake reported on Peninsula
 Aaron Tolentino Thu, October 29, 2026 at 12:48 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Preliminary 2.7 earthquake reported on Peninsula ( KRON ) -- A preliminary 2.7 earthquake shook the Peninsula on Wednesday evening, according to the United States Geological Survey. The quake was reported at 5:17 p.m., and the epicenter was marked in Pacifica, south of Skyline College.
 The depth of the earthquake was reported at 6.5 kilometers or about 4 miles, USGS said. (Location of epicenter pictured below).
